name: PokéBonk
summary:
PokéBonk: a free non-profit 3D Pokémon roguelike survivor you can play in your browser
You can choose your Pokémon and get dropped into an open 3D map while an endless horde closes in.
Your moves fire on their own; your only job is to move, jump and survive. Every kill drops XP, and every level-up gives you a choice of cards. Each run ends up as a different build to reach high positions on the leaderboard.
